arStrings.szText: {c_important}Stone Burst{/c} Slows enemies within the area by {c_number}[SF_21 * 100]%{/c}. Additionally, each time {c_important}Stone Burst{/c} grows larger, it marks the enemies in the area for {c_number}[SF_22 * 100]%{/c} bonus damage from {c_important}Stone Burst's{/c} final explosion, this bonus can stack on enemies and all stacks are consumed at final explosion.

{c_important}Stone Burst{/c} can be channeled infinitely. After reaching the maximum size, continually channeling {c_important}Stone Burst{/c} will periodically detonate, dealing the final explosion damage and consuming {c_resource}[SF_24]{/c} Spirit.

{c_important}Stone Burst{/c} is cast at the targeted location and grows by itself, detonating after {c_number}[SF_34]{/c} seconds. 
Only {c_number}1{/c} {c_important}Stone Burst{/c} may be active at a time.
Reduce the Spirit cost for casting {c_important}Stone Burst{/c} by {c_resource}[SF_27]{/c}.
Gain {c_number}[SF_28 * 100]%{/c} Armor while {c_important}Stone Burst{/c} is channeling.
When {c_important}Stone Burst{/c} reaches its maximum size, gain {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_30 * 100]%{/c} of your Maximum Life.
